scholarships.title: Convocatoria de Becas OEA - UNIR, EP NEWMAN y UNIR Mexico (Curso Academico 2026, 2a convocatoria)
scholarships.official_source: Secretaria General de la Organizacion de los Estados Americanos (SG/OAS) with UNIR, EP NEWMAN and UNIR Mexico

existing.description: The SG/OAS awards tuition discounts for online postgraduate study with UNIR (Spain), the Escuela de Posgrado Peruana de NEWMAN (Peru) and UNIR Mexico. Up to 885 places are offered, with a 60% discount on total tuition for official master's programmes and official degrees, and a 50% discount for UNIR Formación Permanente programmes, applicable only to the value of the study programme. Admission fees, translation and notarisation, study materials, titulation and degree-awarding procedures, and any other cost not listed are explicitly excluded, and recipients must personally demonstrate the financial capacity to cover the uncovered programme costs, so this is not full funding.
eligibility: Seran elegibles los interesados con nacionalidad y/o residencia legal permanente de cualquiera de los Estados Miembros de la SG/OEA, excepto Nicaragua.
No se puede estudiar en su propio pais de origen.
Para ser beneficiario de la beca, el candidato debera haber finalizado el proceso de admision y haber sido admitido en uno de los programas de estudios en una de las instituciones.
No haber recibido otras becas academicas de la OEA, en el mismo nivel de estudios propuesto a esta convocatoria.
Antes de iniciar cualquier Programa, todo Becario debera demostrar su capacidad financiera para solventar los costos del Programa no cubierto por la Beca dentro de un plazo establecido.
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be nationals or permanent legal residents of an OAS Member State except Nicaragua, must not study in their own country of origin, must already have completed admission to a participating programme, must not have held another OAS scholarship at the same level, and must prove they can fund the costs not covered.
benefits: Up to 885 places available across the three institutions for the 2026 academic course.
coverage: 60% discount on the total tuition (colegiatura) for UNIR official master's programmes and official degrees, and for EP NEWMAN and UNIR Mexico official master's programmes.
50% discount on the total tuition for UNIR Formación Permanente programmes.
The discount applies only to the value of the study programme.
requirements: Have been admitted to one of the programmes listed in the call, evidenced by an application letter issued by the institution.
Pay the admission fee (cuota de admision) required by the institution in order to be admitted to the study programme.
Before starting the programme, demonstrate financial capacity to cover the programme costs not covered by the scholarship within the established period.
Maintain an average of 5/10 or higher to keep the scholarship for the duration of the programme.
Not be reported with baja academica through absences from the programme and/or failure of subjects.
application_method: Step 1: Follow the admission process for the chosen programme directly with the institution, submitting all documentation the institution requires, and pay the admission fee.

Step 2: Once admitted and in receipt of the institution's application letter (carta de aplicacion), the applicant is automatically considered a candidate for the OAS-UNIR, EP NEWMAN and UNIR Mexico scholarship; there is no separate scholarship application form.
Step 3: UNIR, EP NEWMAN, UNIR Mexico and the OAS form a specialised committee to select the scholarship holders.
Step 4: Await publication of results at www.oea.org/becas, announced from November 2026 for the 2a convocatoria.

Step 5: Only selected candidates are contacted by email by UNIR, EP NEWMAN and UNIR Mexico with the scholarship offer and acceptance instructions; after accepting, the scholarship holder starts the corresponding payment procedures with the chosen institution.
existing.selection_notes: A specialised committee of UNIR, EP NEWMAN, UNIR Mexico and the OAS selects the scholarship holders, considering the geographic distribution of candidates according to the needs of Member States as reflected in the UNDP Human Development Index, the academic profile and merit and academic credentials, the applicant's potential impact on completing the programme, and gender distribution.
existing.best_fit: Citizens or permanent legal residents of OAS Member States other than Nicaragua, from a country other than the one they plan to study in, who have already been admitted to a participating online programme and can fund the non-discounted portion of the tuition themselves.
existing.notes: This is a tuition discount only and it does not cover the whole fee, so applicants must not treat it as full funding. The 2a convocatoria deadlines fall between 19 and 30 October 2026, so the UNIR and EP NEWMAN lines close first on 19 October 2026. Excluded from eligibility: SG/OAS officials, persons under contract by results with the SG/OAS, Permanent Mission staff, and relatives of all of the above. Nicaraguan nationals and permanent legal residents are excluded. Applicants cannot study in their own country of origin. The call states programme costs shown in the document are orientative and may be lower in some countries, and it repeatedly warns that neither the OAS nor the institutions take responsibility for recognition, legalisation, homologation or convalidacion of the resulting title in the applicant's country of country of origin. The scholarship is conditional on academic performance, and it applies only to the value of the study programme. The SG/OAS reserves the right to cancel this announcement at any point in the process. The document's benefits section refers to a 'Responsabilidades del Becario' section on page 27, but the official PDF available at this URL contains only 10 pages, so that section could not be read.
existing.duration: UNIR Maestrías Oficiales 12 months; UNIR Grados Oficiales 4 years, with the scholarship applying only to the first teaching year of the degree scholarship; UNIR Formación Permanente 21 to 34 weeks; EP NEWMAN maestrías 12 months; UNIR México maestrías 18 or 24 months
existing.application_period: Two calls in the 2026 academic course. 1a convocatoria (Primavera 2026) deadlines ran 16 March to 10 April 2026 and are closed. 2a convocatoria (Otono 2026) is open with deadlines of 19, 26 and 30 October 2026 depending on the institution and programme; selected candidates are announced in November 2026 and programmes start in October/November 2026 depending on the programme.
existing.deadline_display: 2a convocatoria: 19 de octubre de 2026 (UNIR Maestrías Oficiales y Grados Oficiales, and EP NEWMAN); 26 de octubre de 2026 (UNIR Mexico); 30 de octubre de 2026 (UNIR Formacion Permanente)
